about: The mutant ledger of runtime/v1/digest: edits of the leaf's source that its own tests must kill. Its rows moved from runtime/v1's ledger when BS8 moved the code into this leaf. Run it with go run ./scripts/mutants ./runtime/v1/digest (docs/tooling.md, "Mutant ledger").

mutants.name: crc-copies
mutants.rule: Crc32Update does not copy its string to a new slice (FD1-g3).
